session.title: A trip down memory lane with Jeannine

sections.title: Warm-up (5 min)
questions: When you were young in Lyon, what did the streets smell like?
What did you and your friends do on a Sunday in the 1950s?
Who was the best cook in your family? What did they make?

sections.title: Music corner (10 min)
sections.intro: Play one or two songs from each artist, then pause and ask:

items.name: Juliette Gréco
items.description: Juliette Gréco was a renowned French singer and actress, famous for her deep, expressive voice and her significant contributions to the French chanson genre. She became an icon of post-war French culture, known for her poetic and emotive singing style, often collaborating with prominent French poets and songwriters. Her career spanned several decades, during which she also acted in films and theatrical productions.

items.name: Fréhel
items.description: Fréhel, born Marguerite Boulc'h, was a prominent French singer and actress famous for her powerful and emotional performances in the chanson genre during the early 1900s. She was a key figure in Parisian cabaret and musette scenes, known for her distinctive voice and heartfelt delivery. Her career was marked by both critical acclaim and personal struggles, making her an iconic figure in French popular music history.

items.name: Carla Bruni
items.description: Carla Bruni is an Italian-French singer-songwriter and former model who gained fame for her intimate, melodic songs often rooted in the French chanson tradition. She began her career as a model before transitioning to music, releasing several albums that blend folk, pop, and acoustic styles. Bruni is also known for her marriage to former French President Nicolas Sarkozy, which brought her additional public attention beyond her artistic career.

items.name: Françoise Hardy
items.description: Françoise Hardy is a French singer-songwriter and occasional actress whose cool, intimate vocal style and sophisticated image made her one of the defining figures of 1960s French pop and the yé-yé movement. She shot to fame with the 1962 hit "Tous les garçons et les filles," and over decades released albums in French and several other languages, earning a reputation as both a fashionable icon and a thoughtful, melancholic songwriter. Hardy continued recording and touring across many decades, influencing generations of Francophone and international artists with her minimal arrangements, lyrical introspection and elegant persona.

items.name: Yves Montand
items.description: Yves Montand was a French-Italian singer and actor famous for his smooth voice, charismatic stage presence, and contributions to French chanson and cinema. Born Ivo Livi in Italy, he moved to France and became a celebrated figure in French popular culture, known for his romantic and socially conscious songs as well as his film roles.

items.name: Paris Combo
items.description: Paris Combo is a French musical group formed in the mid-1990s, known for their eclectic blend of chanson, jazz, pop, and world music styles. The band combines vintage French chanson with elements of swing, jazz, and electro swing, creating a unique and vibrant sound. Their music often features lively rhythms, accordion, and a mix of male and female vocals, capturing a retro yet contemporary vibe. The group gained international recognition for their sophisticated and playful approach to French popular music.

questions: Does Édith Piaf remind you of anyone?
Where were you when you used to hear Édith Piaf?

sections.title: Film moment (10 min)
sections.intro: Watch a short scene from “La Grande Vadrouille”, then ask:
questions: Did you go to the cinema? Who did you go with?
What did people wear to go out back then?

sections.title: This or that? (5 min)
sections.intro: There is no wrong answer — the goal is to start a story.

sections.title: A taste of home (10 min)
sections.intro: Talk about Gratin dauphinois: who made it, for which occasions, what made it special.
sections.extraTitle: Places near Paris that may serve the food of their childhood:

items.name: Chez Fred, depuis 1945
items.description: Longstanding Parisian bistro serving classic French dishes and seasonal bistronomy in vintage post-war decor with an extensive Burgundy and Bordeaux wine selection.

items.name: Le Bistro Marbeuf
items.description: Elegant wood-paneled Parisian bistro serving classic Lyonnais specialties like onion soup and duck confit with regional wines near the Champs-Élysées.

items.name: Chez René
items.description: Historic Saint-Germain brasserie serving classic French dishes like escargots, tartares and crème caramel in an art-poster hung, literary Latin Quarter setting.

items.name: ANNA - Maison GRF (Grillé Rôti Fondant) Paris 17
items.description: Cozy Parisian French restaurant in the 17th arrondissement offering cocktails, vegetarian options, late-night dining, private dining and an extensive wine list.

sections.title: Notes for the person leading
questions: Keep it short and calm. Stop as soon as they seem tired.
Follow the story they want to tell, not the plan.
Never correct a memory, even if a detail seems wrong.
